wiki.title: Broekwater
wiki.description: The village of Broekwater is squeezed between the Old Coast Road and the Manaanspoort Sea in the Wasteland. A small cluster of fishing hovels, Broekwater has a poor reputation and is said to be a haven for criminals of all sorts. The goods of ships wrecked along the western shore can sometimes be found here.

wiki.title: Almshoven
wiki.description: The ruins of the village of Almshoven lie north of Broekwater. This small village and its lighthouse were destroyed by during the Great War Against Chaos by the Norscan raiders led by the Norscan Reaver Bilespit, a Champion of Nurgle. The village was never rebuilt and now is feared as a diseased, cursed graveyard best avoided by all.

properties.name: Aarnau
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 1e: Marienburg - Sold Down the River

wiki.title: Aarnau
wiki.description: At the very north-eastern tip of the Wasteland, on the border of the Laurelorn Forest, at the far north of the Tumble Downs, at the end of a rutted track grandly named the "Old North Road", sits the border town of Aarnau. Ships stopping here report a quiet settlement of farmers and fisherman, with a surprising martial bent.

wiki.title: Marienburg
wiki.description: Marienburg is the great mercantile city-state of the Wasteland that is considered to be the largest trading hub in the Old World and the greatest of its ports. Straddling the mouth of the River Reik as it drains into the Manaansport Sea and the Sea of Claws, nearly all the maritime trade of Bretonnia and the Empire of Man finds its way here. It is a place of great wealth and great opportunity.
